blocks.text: Buying a Townhome in Pitt Meadows: Complexes, Prices & Locations

parts.t: Because nearly 78% of Pitt Meadows is protected inside the Agricultural Land Reserve (ALR), no new greenfield townhouse subdivisions can sprawl outward—making existing Pitt Meadows strata townhomes one of the tightest sub-markets in the Lower Mainland. In the Greater Vancouver REALTORS® October 2026 MLS® HPI, the Pitt Meadows townhouse benchmark price is $731,800.

Active townhome buyers compare three primary pockets: riverfront and trail-side complexes in South Meadows such as Coho II (19505 111A Ave, built 2007 in Osprey Village near Edith McDermott Elementary), newer and established complexes in Mid Meadows near Meadowtown Centre such as Nature's Walk (19850 Dezeiko Rd, built 2020) and Meadowview Estates (19696 Hammond Rd, built 2004), and central adult-oriented or family complexes such as Twin Oaks (19250 119 Ave, built 1993, 55+ age-restricted).

blocks.text: Pitt Meadows Townhome Strata Review: Garages, Age Rules & Levies

parts.t: Before removing conditions on any Pitt Meadows townhome, we review two full years of strata council and AGM/SGM minutes, the Form B Information Certificate, the latest Depreciation Report (checking roof, siding, deck, and window timelines), age restrictions (several one-level rancher townhome complexes in Central and Mid Meadows are 55+ age-restricted), and garage configuration (tandem vs. side-by-side double garage).

blocks.text: Frequently Asked Questions About Pitt Meadows Townhomes for Sale

parts.t: What is the benchmark price for a townhome in Pitt Meadows?
According to the Greater Vancouver REALTORS® October 2026 MLS® Home Price Index report, the benchmark price for a strata townhome in Pitt Meadows is $731,800.
Where are the main townhome complexes located in Pitt Meadows?
Pitt Meadows townhomes are clustered in three areas:
South Meadows
(Osprey Village along Barnston View Rd and 111A Ave, such as Coho II),
Mid Meadows
(along Hammond Rd, Bonson Rd, and Dezeiko Rd, such as Nature's Walk and Meadowview Estates), and
Central Meadows
near Harris Road and 119 Ave.
Why are townhomes in Pitt Meadows often in short supply?

With 78% of Pitt Meadows land protected inside the Agricultural Land Reserve (ALR) and urban development confined inside the Urban Containment Boundary under the 2040 Official Community Plan, very few new townhome sites can be created.
Are there 55+ age-restricted rancher townhomes in Pitt Meadows?
Yes. Complexes such as Twin Oaks (19250 119 Ave, built 1993) offer 55+ age-restricted rancher and 1.5-storey townhome living in Central and Mid Meadows. You can also browse our dedicated
Pitt Meadows 55+ Townhomes
page.
Which Pitt Meadows townhomes are closest to the West Coast Express?

Townhomes in Central Meadows sit within walking distance of Pitt Meadows West Coast Express Station (12185 Harris Rd), while complexes on the eastern edge of Mid Meadows (such as Nature's Walk and Meadowview Estates) sit right next to Maple Meadows West Coast Express Station.
What should I check in a Pitt Meadows townhome strata package?

Always review the Form B Information Certificate (CRF balance, monthly strata fee, parking assignment, and any special levies), two years of strata minutes, the Depreciation Report, and the strata insurance deductible certificate.
